title: Steller's sea-eagle
description: It belongs to Accipitridae and is an internationally endangered large eagle. With a body length of 88 to 102 cm and a wingspan of 220 to 245 cm, it is the second largest species after the eagle among birds of prey living in Korea. - Scientific name: Haliaeetus pelagicus - Endangered Wildlife Class I, Natural Monument No. 243 - Classification System: Aves > Falconiformes > Accipitridae
